svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: From noise to wisdom
svg.desc: A pyramid with five levels, from the bottom: noise, data, information, knowledge and wisdom, each with an invented factory example. Noise is a bare number. Data adds units, machine, time and source. Information shows load rising for six shifts. Knowledge says rising load on this machine usually means a worn tool. Wisdom decides to change the tool at the next planned stop. A yellow bar marks the bottom three levels as the work of data foundations.

g.text: Change the tool at the next planned stop,
Rising load on this machine usually
for six shifts in a row
A number with no units, time or source

svg.text: The yellow bar marks the levels data foundations work on: context, ownership and quality. An invented example.
